afrikaans_before: JoJo-tenks en reënwaterdromme
back_translation: JoJo tanks and rain barrels

english: Tap points
afrikaans_before: Kraanpunte
back_translation: Tap points

english: Pipes & lines
afrikaans_before: Pype en leidings
back_translation: Pipes and lines

english: Drip irrigation
afrikaans_before: Drupbesproeiing
back_translation: Drip irrigation

english: Swales
afrikaans_before: Kontoerslote
back_translation: Contour swales/ditches
note: Swales shown as "Kontoerslote" (contour ditches); understandable, matches the app-wide term.

english: This site’s own wind data reads {deg}° off the regional pattern — a bimodal wind rose average can land between its two real lobes, not on either one; trust the regional sectors over this site’s single mean.
afrikaans_before: Hierdie terrein se eie winddata wyk {deg}° af van die streekspatroon — 'n gemiddelde van 'n windroos met twee pieke kan tussen sy twee werklike pieke beland, nie op enigeen van hulle nie; vertrou eerder die streekssektore as hierdie terrein se enkele gemiddelde.
back_translation: This site's own wind data deviates {deg}° from the regional pattern - an average of a wind rose with two peaks can land between its two real peaks, not on either of them; rather trust the regional sectors than this site's single average.

english: Slope direction is estimated from a site-local SRTM sample across about {m} m — indicative, not surveyed.
afrikaans_before: Die hellingrigting word beraam uit 'n terreinplaaslike SRTM-steekproef oor ongeveer {m} m — 'n aanduiding, nie opgemeet nie.
back_translation: The slope direction is estimated from a site-local SRTM sample over about {m} m - an indication, not surveyed.

english: Site reads ~flat at this {m} m sampling scale — confirm fall on site.
afrikaans_before: Die terrein lyk ~plat by hierdie steekproefskaal van {m} m — bevestig die afloop ter plaatse.
back_translation: The site looks ~flat at this sample scale of {m} m - confirm the runoff on site.

english: Wind confirmed on site: {from}
afrikaans_before: Wind ter plaatse bevestig: {from}
back_translation: Wind confirmed on site: {from}

english: Wind confirmed on site: {from} (recorded {date})
afrikaans_before: Wind ter plaatse bevestig: {from} (aangeteken {date})
back_translation: Wind confirmed on site: {from} (recorded {date})

english: Place within 3 m of a roof downpipe on a compacted, level base.
afrikaans_before: Plaas binne 3 m van 'n dakreënpyp op 'n vasgetrapte, gelyke basis.
back_translation: Place within 3 m of a roof downpipe on a firm, level base.

english: Needs a solid concrete ring base — full tank weighs ~2.5 t.
afrikaans_before: Het 'n soliede betonringbasis nodig — 'n volle tenk weeg ~2.5 t.
back_translation: Needs a solid concrete ring base - a full tank weighs ~2.5 t.

english: 1.85 m diameter — check eave clearance and allow space to walk around for maintenance.
afrikaans_before: Deursnee van 1.85 m — kontroleer dat die dakrand nie in die pad is nie en laat ruimte om rond te stap vir instandhouding.
back_translation: Diameter 1.85 m - check that the roof edge is not in the way and leave room to walk around for maintenance.

english: 2.2 m diameter, 3.15 m tall — site on a reinforced slab near the largest roof catchment.
afrikaans_before: Deursnee van 2.2 m, 3.15 m hoog — plaas op 'n versterkte plaat naby die grootste dakopvanggebied.
back_translation: Diameter 2.2 m, 3.15 m high - place on a reinforced slab near the largest roof catchment area.

english: Good starter option under a small downpipe before investing in a JoJo.
afrikaans_before: Goeie beginkeuse onder 'n klein reënpyp voordat jy in 'n JoJo belê.
back_translation: A good starter choice under a small downpipe before you invest in a JoJo.

english: Line with clay or pond liner; site in a natural low point to catch runoff.
afrikaans_before: Bekle met klei of damvoering; plaas in 'n natuurlike laagte om afloopwater te vang.
back_translation: Line with clay or dam lining; place in a natural low spot to catch runoff water.

english: Site on-contour below a catchment area; check DWS licensing thresholds for dam size.
afrikaans_before: Plaas op die kontoer onderkant 'n opvanggebied; kontroleer die DWS se lisensiedrempels vir damgrootte.
back_translation: Place on the contour below a catchment area; check the DWS licence thresholds for dam size.

english: Get a hydrogeological siting survey before drilling — avoid septic/kraal runoff zones.
afrikaans_before: Kry 'n hidrogeologiese terreinkeuse-opname voordat daar geboor word — vermy sones waar septiese-tenk- of kraalafloop kom.
back_translation: Get a hydrogeological site-selection survey before drilling - avoid zones where septic tank or kraal runoff comes.
note: Safety checked: survey before drilling, avoid septic/kraal runoff zones intact.

english: Place at bed corners for easy hose access without crossing paths.
afrikaans_before: Plaas by die beddinghoeke sodat jy maklik met 'n tuinslang kan bykom sonder om oor paadjies te loop.
back_translation: Place at the bed corners so you can easily reach with a garden hose without walking across paths.

english: Position on firm, well-drained ground away from the dam edge to reduce erosion.
afrikaans_before: Plaas op vaste, goed gedreineerde grond weg van die damrand om erosie te verminder.
back_translation: Place on firm, well-drained ground away from the dam edge to reduce erosion.

english: On the downpipe before the tank — diverts the first dirty roof runoff (leaves, dust, bird mess) so only clean water is stored.
afrikaans_before: Op die reënpyp voor die tenk — lei die eerste vuil dakafloop weg (blare, stof, voëlmis) sodat net skoon water gestoor word.
back_translation: On the downpipe before the tank - diverts the first dirty roof runoff away (leaves, dust, bird droppings) so only clean water is stored.

english: Site near the tanks on a firm base — regulates pressure for drip lines and filters grit before irrigation.
afrikaans_before: Plaas naby die tenks op 'n vaste basis — reguleer die druk vir druplyne en filtreer growwe sand uit voordat daar besproei word.
back_translation: Place near the tanks on a firm base - regulates the pressure for drip lines and filters coarse sand out before irrigating.

english: Keep it 1.2 m wide — any wider and you cannot reach the middle from both sides. Fill 30-40 cm deep over loosened subsoil.
afrikaans_before: Hou dit 1.2 m breed — as dit breër is, kan jy nie van altwee kante by die middel uitkom nie. Vul 30-40 cm diep oor losgemaakte ondergrond.
back_translation: Keep it 1.2 m wide - if wider, you can't reach the middle from both sides. Fill 30-40 cm deep over loosened subsoil.

english: Central compost basket feeds the whole bed — ideal near the kitchen door.
afrikaans_before: Die middelste komposmandjie voed die hele bedding — ideaal naby die kombuisdeur.
back_translation: The middle compost basket feeds the whole bed - ideal near the kitchen door.

english: Build up to 1-1.2 m high with rubble core; place right outside the kitchen door.
afrikaans_before: Bou tot 1-1.2 m hoog met 'n kern van puin; plaas reg buite die kombuisdeur.
back_translation: Build up to 1-1.2 m high with a core of rubble; place right outside the kitchen door.

english: Dig a 2 m pit for the compost core; feeds off greywater and kitchen waste.
afrikaans_before: Grawe 'n put van 2 m vir die komposkern; word gevoed deur gryswater en kombuisafval.
back_translation: Dig a 2 m pit for the compost core; fed by greywater and kitchen waste.

english: Plant the tree on a low raised mound, then ring it with a mulch-filled moat — roof or greywater runoff soaks in through the ring, at the feeder roots, while the trunk and crown stay high and dry. Never plant a fruit tree standing in the dip.
afrikaans_before: Plant die boom op 'n lae, opgehoogde hopie en omring dit met 'n gleuf vol deklaag — dakafloop of gryswater sypel deur die ring in, by die voedingswortels, terwyl die stam en kroon hoog en droog bly. Moet nooit 'n vrugteboom plant wat in die laagte staan nie.
back_translation: Plant the tree on a low, raised mound and surround it with a trench full of mulch - roof runoff or greywater seeps in through the ring, at the feeding roots, while the trunk and crown stay high and dry. Never plant a fruit tree that stands in the low spot.
note: "wat in die laagte staan" is slightly awkward (a tree standing in the dip) but the "Moet nooit ... nie" prohibition and the siting meaning are intact.

english: Feed from kitchen/laundry outlet into a mulch-filled banana or fruit tree basin.
afrikaans_before: Voed vanaf die kombuis-/wasgoeduitlaat in 'n piesang- of vrugteboomkom vol deklaag.
back_translation: Feed from the kitchen/laundry outlet into a banana or fruit tree basin full of mulch.

english: Where greywater LEAVES the house — the bath, shower, basin or laundry drain you are tapping. Put it on that wall, then run the line to a banana circle or tree basin. Never tap the toilet (that is blackwater), and use plant-safe soap.
afrikaans_before: Waar gryswater die huis VERLAAT — die bad-, storte-, wasbak- of wasgoeduitlaat wat jy aftap. Sit dit teen daardie muur en lei die leiding dan na 'n piesangsirkel of boomkom. Moet nooit die toilet aftap nie (dit is swartwater), en gebruik plantveilige seep.
back_translation: Where greywater LEAVES the house - the bath, shower, basin or laundry outlet that you tap off. Put it against that wall and then run the pipe to a banana circle or tree basin. Never tap the toilet (that is blackwater), and use plant-safe soap.
note: Safety checked: LEAVES the house, never tap the toilet (blackwater), plant-safe soap all intact.

english: Valve plus leaf filter on the outlet: sends greywater to the garden in the dry season, and back to the sewer or soakaway when you need it to.
afrikaans_before: Klep plus blaarfilter op die uitlaat: stuur gryswater in die droë seisoen na die tuin, en terug na die riool of sypelput wanneer jy dit nodig het.
back_translation: Valve plus leaf filter on the outlet: send greywater to the garden in the dry season, and back to the sewer or soakaway when you need it.
note: "wanneer jy dit nodig het" drops the "need it to" wording; same instruction.

english: A shallow flat-bottomed dish (30-50 cm deep) that ponds runoff so it soaks away. Site where water already collects, but keep 5 m clear of foundations.
afrikaans_before: 'n Vlak skottel met 'n plat bodem (30-50 cm diep) wat afloopwater laat opdam sodat dit wegsypel. Plaas dit waar water reeds versamel, maar hou 5 m weg van fondamente.
back_translation: A shallow dish with a flat bottom (30-50 cm deep) that lets runoff water pond so that it seeps away. Place it where water already collects, but keep 5 m away from foundations.

english: Semi-circular earth bund (demi-lune) with the arms on contour and the opening uphill — Sahel technique to water one tree in dry country.
afrikaans_before: Halfsirkelvormige grondwal (demi-lune) met die arms op die kontoer en die opening opdraand — 'n Sahel-tegniek om een boom in droë land te natmaak.
back_translation: Half-circle earth wall (demi-lune) with the arms on the contour and the opening uphill - a Sahel technique for watering one tree in dry land.

english: A raised earth ridge on contour. Either the mound on the downhill side of a swale trench, or a standalone contour bank that catches runoff and leads it to a safe outlet. Plant it as soon as it is built so it binds.
afrikaans_before: 'n Opgehoogde grondrif op die kontoer. Dit is óf die hoop aan die afdraandkant van 'n kontoerslootgreppel, óf 'n losstaande kontoerwal wat afloopwater vang en na 'n veilige uitlaat lei. Plant dit sodra dit gebou is, sodat dit bind.
back_translation: A raised earth ridge on the contour. It is either the heap on the downhill side of a contour swale trench, or a free-standing contour bund that catches runoff water and leads it to a safe outlet. Plant it as soon as it is built, so that it binds.

english: Cut-and-fill a level shelf across steep ground (steeper than ~1:5). Retain the face with rock, gabion or vetiver or it will slump.
afrikaans_before: Sny en vul 'n gelyk rak dwarsoor steil grond (steiler as ~1:5). Keer die vlak met klip, gabion of vetiver, anders sak dit in.
back_translation: Cut and fill a level shelf across steep ground (steeper than ~1:5). Hold back the face with stone, gabion or vetiver, otherwise it slumps.
note: "Keer die vlak" (hold back the face) is terse; "vlak" could be read as "level", intent (retain it with stone/gabion/vetiver or it slumps) still clear.

english: A living bank of vetiver you cut again and again for mulch and compost. Use the sterile, non-seeding cultivar — not a seeding local relative — so it stays a mulch bank and not a spreading grass. Slash it a few times a season, drop the leaf straight onto beds and tree basins. Its deep roots also hold the soil where it stands.
afrikaans_before: 'n Lewende wal van vetiver wat jy telkens afsny vir deklaag en kompos. Gebruik die steriele kultivar wat nie saad maak nie — nie 'n plaaslike familielid wat saad maak nie — sodat dit 'n deklaagwal bly en nie 'n gras word wat versprei nie. Sny dit 'n paar keer per seisoen af en laat die blare reguit op beddings en boomkomme val. Sy diep wortels hou ook die grond vas waar dit staan.
back_translation: A living ridge of vetiver that you repeatedly cut for mulch and compost. Use the sterile cultivar that does not make seed - not a local relative that makes seed - so that it stays a mulch ridge and does not become a grass that spreads. Cut it a few times per season and let the leaves fall straight onto beds and tree basins. Its deep roots also hold the soil where it stands.
note: Safety checked: sterile non-seeding cultivar, not a seeding local relative.

english: Keep tools near the main work zone but out of prevailing rain direction.
afrikaans_before: Hou gereedskap naby die hoofwerksone, maar buite die rigting waaruit die reën gewoonlik kom.
back_translation: Keep tools near the main work zone, but out of the direction the rain usually comes from.

english: Orient the ridge north-south for even light; anchor well against wind.
afrikaans_before: Rig die nok noord-suid vir eweredige lig; anker dit goed teen wind.
back_translation: Align the ridge north-south for even light; anchor it well against wind.

english: Use 40-50% shade netting for SA summer sun; site near the nursery table.
afrikaans_before: Gebruik 40-50% skadunet vir die SA somerson; plaas naby die kwekerytafel.
back_translation: Use 40-50% shade net for the SA summer sun; place near the nursery table.

english: Close enough for daily egg collection, downwind of the house.
afrikaans_before: Naby genoeg om daagliks eiers te versamel, aan die kant waarheen die wind van die huis af waai.
back_translation: Close enough to collect eggs daily, on the side toward which the wind blows away from the house.
note: Checked: downwind phrased as the side the wind blows away from the house.

english: Movable — rotate across beds or orchard rows for pest control and manure.
afrikaans_before: Verskuifbaar — wissel dit oor beddings of boordrye vir plaagbeheer en mis.
back_translation: Movable - rotate it over beds or orchard rows for pest control and manure.

english: Site downhill and downwind of the house; capture runoff for a manure compost pit.
afrikaans_before: Plaas afdraand en aan die kant waarheen die wind van die huis af waai; vang afloopwater vir 'n miskomposput.
back_translation: Place downhill and on the side toward which the wind blows away from the house; catch runoff water for a manure compost pit.

english: Three ~1x1m bins in a row for turning stages; keep near veg beds to shorten wheelbarrow runs.
afrikaans_before: Drie ~1x1m-bakke in 'n ry vir die omdraaistadia; hou naby groentebeddings om kruiwaritte te verkort.
back_translation: Three ~1x1m bins in a row for the turning stages; keep near vegetable beds to shorten wheelbarrow trips.

english: Keep in shade near the kitchen for easy scrap disposal.
afrikaans_before: Hou in die skaduwee naby die kombuis sodat afvalreste maklik weggegooi kan word.
back_translation: Keep in the shade near the kitchen so scraps are easy to throw away.

english: Site close to a tap for daily seedling watering.
afrikaans_before: Plaas naby 'n kraan om saailinge daagliks nat te maak.
back_translation: Place near a tap to water seedlings daily.

english: Keep it clear of greywater, thorny species and vehicle access — and site it where it can be seen from the kitchen or classroom.
afrikaans_before: Hou dit weg van gryswater, doringrige spesies en voertuigtoegang — en plaas dit waar dit vanaf die kombuis of klaskamer gesien kan word.
back_translation: Keep it away from greywater, thorny species and vehicle access - and place it where it can be seen from the kitchen or classroom.

english: Place near the gate/road frontage for customer access.
afrikaans_before: Plaas naby die hek/padfront sodat kliënte dit kan bereik.
back_translation: Place near the gate/road frontage so customers can reach it.

english: Keep within daily-visit distance of the kitchen door; full sun, north-facing rows.
afrikaans_before: Hou binne daaglikse besoekafstand van die kombuisdeur; volson, rye wat noord kyk.
back_translation: Keep within daily visiting distance of the kitchen door; full sun, rows facing north.

english: Full sun, frost-protected spot; keep 4 m from structures for mature canopy.
afrikaans_before: Volson, 'n plek wat teen ryp beskerm is; hou 4 m van geboue vir die volwasse kroon.
back_translation: Full sun, a place protected from frost; keep 4 m from buildings for the mature crown.

english: The most frost-hardy of the citrus — still wants full sun and 4 m clearance at maturity.
afrikaans_before: Die rypbestandste van die sitrus — wil steeds volson hê en 4 m vrye ruimte wanneer dit volwasse is.
back_translation: The most frost-hardy of the citrus - still wants full sun and 4 m of clear space when mature.

english: Needs more heat than other citrus and a longer frost-free spell; full sun, 5 m clearance at maturity.
afrikaans_before: Het meer hitte as ander sitrus nodig en 'n langer rypvrye tydperk; volson, 5 m vrye ruimte wanneer dit volwasse is.
back_translation: Needs more heat than other citrus and a longer frost-free period; full sun, 5 m of clear space when mature.

english: Mature canopy can reach 10 m+ — give it real room, frost-free warm zone.
afrikaans_before: Die volwasse kroon kan 10 m+ bereik — gee dit werklik ruimte, 'n rypvrye warm sone.
back_translation: The mature crown can reach 10 m+ - really give it space, a frost-free warm zone.

english: Needs good drainage, wind shelter, and 8 m clearance at maturity.
afrikaans_before: Het goeie dreinering, windbeskutting en 8 m vrye ruimte nodig wanneer dit volwasse is.
back_translation: Needs good drainage, wind shelter and 8 m of clear space when mature.

english: Slow-growing but wide canopy eventually — plant well back from paths and beds.
afrikaans_before: Groei stadig, maar het uiteindelik 'n wye kroon — plant ver terug van paadjies en beddings.
back_translation: Grows slowly but eventually has a wide crown - plant far back from paths and beds.

english: Hidden from new designs because guava can be invasive in warm coastal areas. Kept so old saved designs still render.
afrikaans_before: Versteek in nuwe ontwerpe omdat koejawel in warm kusgebiede 'n indringer kan wees. Behou sodat ou gestoorde ontwerpe steeds korrek wys.
back_translation: Hidden in new designs because guava can be an invader in warm coastal areas. Kept so old saved designs still display correctly.
note: Checked: guava invasive on warm coasts, kept so old designs show.

english: Wide dense canopy at maturity — needs subtropical frost-free conditions.
afrikaans_before: Wye, digte kroon wanneer dit volwasse is — het subtropiese, rypvrye toestande nodig.
back_translation: Wide, dense crown when mature - needs subtropical, frost-free conditions.

english: Fast-growing and short-lived — good gap-filler near the kitchen garden.
afrikaans_before: Groei vinnig en leef kort — 'n goeie gaping-vuller naby die kombuistuin.
back_translation: Grows fast and lives short - a good gap-filler near the kitchen garden.

english: Prune hard annually for leaf harvest to control size near beds.
afrikaans_before: Snoei elke jaar hard vir blaaroes om die grootte naby beddings te beheer.
back_translation: Prune hard every year for a leaf harvest to control the size near beds.

english: Indigenous fruiting coastal shrub/tree; useful as an edible hedge or small orchard edge.
afrikaans_before: Inheemse vrugdraende kusstruik/-boom; nuttig as 'n eetbare heining of klein boordrand.
back_translation: Indigenous fruit-bearing coastal shrub/tree; useful as an edible hedge or small orchard edge.

english: This is the coastal/subtropical Wild Plum (Harpephyllum caffrum), umgwenya — not the drier-region Wild Plum (Pappea capensis), which is a smaller tree not yet in this catalog. Give it room away from beds and buildings.
afrikaans_before: Dit is die kus-/subtropiese Wild Plum (Harpephyllum caffrum), umgwenya — nie die Wild Plum van droër streke (Pappea capensis) nie, wat 'n kleiner boom is wat nog nie in hierdie katalogus is nie. Gee dit ruimte weg van beddings en geboue.
back_translation: This is the coastal/subtropical Wild Plum (Harpephyllum caffrum), umgwenya - not the Wild Plum of drier regions (Pappea capensis), which is a smaller tree not yet in this catalogue. Give it space away from beds and buildings.

english: Indigenous fruiting shade tree for moister edges and wildlife-friendly food forest zones.
afrikaans_before: Inheemse vrugdraende skaduboom vir vogtiger rande en wildvriendelike voedselwoudsones.
back_translation: Indigenous fruit-bearing shade tree for moister edges and wildlife-friendly food forest zones.

english: Big savanna shade tree — give it 12 m and keep it well back from buildings. Only female trees fruit, so plant several seedlings if you want a crop.
afrikaans_before: Groot savanne-skadubook — gee dit 12 m en hou dit ver van geboue af. Net vroulike bome dra vrugte, so plant verskeie saailinge as jy 'n oes wil hê.
back_translation: Large savanna shade tree - give it 12 m and keep it far from buildings. Only female trees bear fruit, so plant several seedlings if you want a harvest.
note: Checked: only female trees fruit; 12 m.

english: Thorny and very hardy — takes frost, drought and wind. Grown as a stock-proof edible hedge as often as a single tree. Only female plants fruit.
afrikaans_before: Doringrig en baie bestand — verdra ryp, droogte en wind. Word net so dikwels as 'n vee-bestande eetbare heining gekweek as as 'n enkele boom. Net vroulike plante dra vrugte.
back_translation: Thorny and very resilient - tolerates frost, drought and wind. Is grown just as often as a livestock-resistant edible hedge as as a single tree. Only female plants bear fruit.
note: "vee-bestande heining" reads as livestock-resistant hedge = stock-proof; not the xh "protects livestock" error. "Net so dikwels as" keeps "as often as"; "Net vroulike plante dra vrugte" keeps the female-only caveat.

english: Place the canopy, then tap it and rename it to the exact species.
afrikaans_before: Plaas die kroon, tik dan daarop en hernoem dit na die presiese spesie.
back_translation: Place the crown, then tap on it and rename it to the exact species.

english: Heavy feeder — site near greywater outflow or compost area.
afrikaans_before: Groot voeter — plaas naby die gryswateruitvloei of komposarea.
back_translation: Heavy feeder - place near the greywater outflow or compost area.

english: Use for windbreaks and wildlife corridors on the property edge.
afrikaans_before: Gebruik vir windskerms en wildkorridors aan die rand van die eiendom.
back_translation: Use for windbreaks and wildlife corridors on the edge of the property.

english: Needs winter cold (chill) to fruit — good on the Highveld; pick a low-chill variety in milder spots.
afrikaans_before: Het wintersköue (koue-ure) nodig om vrugte te dra — goed op die Hoëveld; kies 'n variëteit met lae kouebehoefte in sagter plekke.
back_translation: Needs winter cold (chill hours) to bear fruit - good on the Highveld; choose a variety with low chill requirement in milder places.

english: Cold-hardy and long-lived; needs a second variety nearby for good pollination.
afrikaans_before: Koue-bestand en leef lank; het 'n tweede variëteit in die nabyheid nodig vir goeie bestuiwing.
back_translation: Cold-resistant and lives long; needs a second variety nearby for good pollination.

english: Frost-hardy stone fruit; blossoms early so avoid the coldest frost pockets.
afrikaans_before: Rypbestande steenvrug; blom vroeg, so vermy die koudste ryp-kolle.
back_translation: Frost-resistant stone fruit; blooms early, so avoid the coldest frost spots.

english: Prune to an open vase each winter; needs some chill but tolerates mild-frost hinterland too.
afrikaans_before: Snoei elke winter tot 'n oop vaasvorm; het 'n mate van koue nodig, maar verdra ook die binneland met ligte ryp.
back_translation: Prune each winter to an open vase shape; needs a measure of cold, but also tolerates the inland with light frost.

english: Very adaptable — handles frost, heat and dry spells. Roots are vigorous, keep clear of walls/pipes.
afrikaans_before: Baie aanpasbaar — hanteer ryp, hitte en droë tydperke. Die wortels is kragtig, hou weg van mure/pype.
back_translation: Very adaptable - handles frost, heat and dry periods. The roots are powerful, keep away from walls/pipes.

english: Loves hot dry summers; drought-hardy once established. Good for Karoo and Highveld gardens.
afrikaans_before: Hou van warm, droë somers; droogtebestand sodra dit gevestig is. Goed vir Karoo- en Hoëveldtuine.
back_translation: Likes warm, dry summers; drought-resistant once established. Good for Karoo and Highveld gardens.

english: Mediterranean and Karoo star — drought- and frost-tolerant; needs a dry, sunny, well-drained spot.
afrikaans_before: Mediterreense en Karoo-ster — verdra droogte en ryp; het 'n droë, sonnige, goed gedreineerde plek nodig.
back_translation: Mediterranean and Karoo star - tolerates drought and frost; needs a dry, sunny, well-drained spot.

english: Anything the catalog does not cover yet — place it, then tap it to give it a name.
afrikaans_before: Enigiets wat die katalogus nog nie dek nie — plaas dit en tik dan daarop om dit 'n naam te gee.
back_translation: Anything the catalogue does not cover yet - place it and then tap on it to give it a name.

english: Mix indigenous flowering species along orchard edges to boost fruit set.
afrikaans_before: Meng inheemse blomspesies langs boordrande om vrugset te bevorder.
back_translation: Mix indigenous flowering species along orchard edges to promote fruit set.

english: Plant cuttings 20-30 cm apart as a firebreak/browse hedge — extremely drought-hardy.
afrikaans_before: Plant steggies 20-30 cm uitmekaar as 'n brandstrook-/weiheining — uiters droogtebestand.
back_translation: Plant cuttings 20-30 cm apart as a firebreak/grazing hedge - extremely drought-resistant.
note: "weiheining" suggests a grazing hedge where English says browse hedge; fire-break and spacing intact.

english: Plant on-contour with slips 10-15 cm apart to stop erosion on slopes. Use the sterile, non-seeding cultivar so the line holds ground rather than spreading as a seeding grass.
afrikaans_before: Plant op die kontoer met lote 10-15 cm uitmekaar om erosie op hellings te stop. Gebruik die steriele kultivar wat nie saad maak nie, sodat die lyn die grond vashou eerder as om te versprei as 'n gras wat saad maak.
back_translation: Plant on the contour with slips 10-15 cm apart to stop erosion on slopes. Use the sterile cultivar that does not make seed, so that the line holds the soil rather than spreading as a grass that makes seed.

english: Face entrance east, away from foot traffic; keep 5-10 m clear approach path.
afrikaans_before: Laat die ingang oos kyk, weg van voetverkeer; hou 'n oop toegangspad van 5-10 m.
back_translation: Let the entrance face east, away from foot traffic; keep an open access path of 5-10 m.

english: Sturdy fencing essential — goats browse anything reachable, keep away from young trees.
afrikaans_before: Stewige heinings is noodsaaklik — bokke vreet alles wat hulle kan bykom, hou weg van jong bome.
back_translation: Sturdy fences are essential - goats eat everything they can reach, keep away from young trees.

english: Downhill of water sources, with shade and a wallow; strong odour control needed near house.
afrikaans_before: Afdraand van waterbronne, met skaduwee en 'n suiplek; sterk reukbeheer is nodig naby die huis.
back_translation: Downhill of water sources, with shade and a drinking place; strong odour control is needed near the house.
afrikaans_after: Afdraand van waterbronne, met skaduwee en 'n modderbad om in te wentel; sterk reukbeheer is nodig naby die huis.
note: REPAIR: "suiplek" means a drinking/watering place, so the pig wallow was lost. Now "modderbad om in te wentel" (mud bath to wallow in).

english: Pair with the orchard for natural snail and pest control.
afrikaans_before: Koppel aan die boord vir natuurlike slak- en plaagbeheer.
back_translation: Pair with the orchard for natural snail and pest control.

english: Raise off ground; manure drops straight to a compost or worm bin below.
afrikaans_before: Verhoog van die grond af; mis val reguit in 'n kompos- of wurmbak daaronder.
back_translation: Raised off the ground; manure falls straight into a compost or worm bin below.

english: Place at the kraal fence line for easy refilling without entering the pen.
afrikaans_before: Plaas by die kraalheining sodat dit maklik gevul kan word sonder om die kraal binne te gaan.
back_translation: Place at the kraal fence so that it can be filled easily without going into the kraal.

english: Site near the kraal/pig pen for manure feedstock; pipe gas to the kitchen.
afrikaans_before: Plaas naby die kraal/varkhok vir miskoevoer; lei die gas deur 'n pyp na die kombuis.
back_translation: Place near the kraal/pig pen for manure feedstock; pipe the gas to the kitchen.

english: Anchor over seating or nursery areas; orient to block harsh afternoon sun.
afrikaans_before: Anker oor sitplekke of kwekeryareas; rig dit om die skerp middagson te keer.
back_translation: Anchor over seating or nursery areas; orient it to block the harsh afternoon sun.

english: Align with the main path for straightforward vehicle and foot access.
afrikaans_before: Rig in lyn met die hoofpad vir eenvoudige voertuig- en voetgangertoegang.
back_translation: Align with the main path for simple vehicle and pedestrian access.

english: Site under shade with a view over the main growing area.
afrikaans_before: Plaas in die skaduwee met 'n uitsig oor die hoofgroeigebied.
back_translation: Place in the shade with a view over the main growing area.

english: Place at path junctions for orientation or market-day signage.
afrikaans_before: Plaas by paadjie-kruisings vir oriëntering of markdagbordjies.
back_translation: Place at path crossings for orientation or market-day signs.

english: Angle north-facing and unshaded for peak SA solar yield.
afrikaans_before: Kantel na die noorde en sonder skaduwee vir die hoogste sonkragopbrengs in SA.
back_translation: Tilt toward the north and without shade for the highest solar yield in SA.

english: Site in full sun close to the house, clear of tree drip lines.
afrikaans_before: Plaas in volson naby die huis, weg van die druplyne van bome.
back_translation: Place in full sun near the house, away from the drip lines of trees.
